acceptance_checks: With default python_files patterns, running pytest on a directory containing foobar/__init__.py with import-failing code does not import that initializer and produces no collection error.
A matching test file beneath foobar is still collected and executed without importing foobar/__init__.py.
When python_files is configured to include __init__.py, a recursively discovered initializer retains existing import and collection behavior, including surfacing import failures as collection errors.
Passing __init__.py directly retains existing import and collection behavior, including surfacing import failures as collection errors.
Existing tests covering collection of initializer tests under broadened python_files configuration continue to pass.
Existing tests covering direct __init__.py arguments continue to pass.
Existing collect_ignore behavior continues to prevent collection or import within ignored package trees.
A focused regression test distinguishes the fixed behavior from the previous item-count-only coverage by placing failing code in an unselected initializer under an ordinary directory invocation.
The full relevant collection test suite passes without requiring preservation of the Package collector hierarchy for unselected initializers.
confirmed_decisions: For an ordinary directory invocation, a recursively encountered __init__.py that does not match python_files must be ignored rather than imported to establish package collection semantics.
Explicitly passed __init__.py files retain their existing import and collection behavior.
Recursively encountered __init__.py files that match python_files retain their existing import and collection behavior.
Matching descendant test files remain discoverable and runnable when their package's unselected __init__.py is not imported.
Internal collector or node hierarchy may change for directories whose initializer is unselected.
Existing pytest_ignore_collect behavior must remain effective.
summary: Fix the pytest 5.2.3 regression by preventing recursively discovered package initializers from being imported unless they are selected for collection. An initializer is selected when it matches the configured python_files patterns or is passed explicitly. A recursively encountered, unselected __init__.py must not be imported, but matching test files beneath its directory must still be discovered and executed. Preserving the existing internal Package collector hierarchy for unselected initializers is not required.
